title: Constructible cohomology endofunctor
statement: Let $C$ be a preadditive category with a zero object, integer shift functors whose functors are additive, and a pretriangulated structure. Let $t$ be a t-structure on $C$ [def-weil-t-structure], with truncation functors $\tau_t^{\le i}$ and $\tau_t^{\ge i}$, and let $i\in\mathbf Z$. Define the cohomology endofunctor $\mathcal H_t^i:C\to C$ by $\mathcal H_t^i=(\tau_t^{\ge i}\circ\tau_t^{\le i})[i]$: on objects $K$ it sends $K$ to $(\tau_t^{\ge i}\tau_t^{\le i}K)[i]$, and on arrows it applies these same two truncation functors followed by the shift functor. For a standard constructible t-structure this is the standard constructible cohomology object placed in degree zero.

source.place: Cohomology display: H^i(K) = (tau^{>=i} tau^{<=i} K)[i]; existing generic implementation in Sheaf.Paper.ConstructibleTruncations.
